name: ownmemory
description: OwnMemory: Claude remembers you across chats and devices, with memories encrypted under a key only you hold, in storage you own.

OWNER_CODE.description: **At least 12 characters**, random: generate it in your password manager and keep it there; don't reuse a password. You enter it once, when you first connect, to set up a passkey or an authenticator app. After that it's only used with your authenticator code, or to reset sign-in if you lose your devices.

STORAGE.description: Leave as **d1**: memories are stored, encrypted, in a database in your own Cloudflare account.
